name: PF-CH corridor (double track, with intermediate stops)

metadata.source: Gleisschema strip above the PF-CH train graph
metadata.note: Double track throughout except MH--TIEF; double crossover at every location; platforms only at the boxed stations. Track counts live in the LOCATIONS table of build_corridor_scene.py. Each train additionally calls at up to three intermediate stations between its origin and destination (`via`), so the corridor has planned transfers instead of only origin-destination runs.
